Policies & Procedures LMS Assignment Blu: Decision-ready map for one General pathway plus the 12 requested roles • review date 2026-07-20

Assign the eight General courses to every employee pathway (LVN through DON), then add the role-specific courses. Governing Body members use their 13-course standalone track and do not automatically inherit employee-only HR/Cal-OSHA content.

Every policy listed in Policy Assignments is read and tested through its course-level quiz. One quiz may cover multiple related policies. Default pass score is 80%; OASIS is 85%. A quiz never substitutes for required observation, return demonstration, coding exercise, drill, interactive Q&A, or supervised practice.

A policy was not made a separate scored assignment when it was an owner-only procedure, a billing/IT/HR function outside the selected pathways, a duplicate/consolidated source, or acknowledgment/reference material without a defensible need for a quiz. Exclusion from the LMS quiz map does not remove operational access or other acknowledgment duties.

Do not publish any red/hold component until the policy owner resolves the source defect. The critical blockers are missing job-description bodies, the OASIS authority/canonical-source conflict, the incorrect California harassment statement, and GV-GB-001 missing from the generated library. Use Release Blockers as the owner checklist.

Recommended reconciliation: General orientation by day 5; all initial read/quiz assignments by day 14; role competency by day 30 and always before independent duty, first exposure, or specialty assignment. Annual/biennial rules and triggered refreshers remain course-specific.
